description: This Java source file defines the SessionManager class for managing Hive sessions within the HiveServer2 component, including session lifecycle, timeout handling, and background task execution.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: Manages Hive sessions, handles session creation, closure, timeout checks, and background operations within HiveServer2.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SessionManager with Hive configuration, sets up operation logging and background thread pool.

methods.name: createBackgroundOperationPool
methods.description: Creates and configures the thread pool for background operations based on Hive configuration.

methods.name: initOperationLogRootDir
methods.description: Initializes the directory for operation logs if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the SessionManager and begins session timeout checking if configured.

methods.name: startTimeoutChecker
methods.description: Starts a background thread to periodically check for session timeouts and expired operations.

methods.name: shutdownTimeoutChecker
methods.description: Signals the timeout checker thread to stop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the SessionManager, shuts down background thread pool, and cleans up logs.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Creates a new Hive session, returns a session handle, with optional impersonation.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes and removes a Hive session identified by its handle.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves a Hive session by its handle.

methods.name: getOperationManager
methods.description: Returns the OperationManager instance managing ongoing operations.

methods.name: submitBackgroundOperation
methods.description: Submits a Runnable task to the background operation thread pool.

methods.name: getOpenSessionCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of open sessions.
